rows.quote: We conducted a proteome-wide Mendelian randomization (MR) study of 2,923 plasma proteins using cis-protein quantitative trait loci from 34,557 European participants in the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, integrated with genome-wide association studies of 156,901 breast cancer cases and 204,634 controls of European, East Asian, and African ancestries.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states cis-pQTLs from exactly 34,557 European participants of the project, matching one candidate row only; platform and year are not in the sentence.
